image_description: A beige golf cart with a white canopy carrying two women. The driver is on the right, and the passenger is on the left. The background shows a grassy area with trees and what appears to be a golf course setting. The image has a slightly soft, painterly quality typical of some AI generations or heavy filtering.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The driver's hands appear to merge into the steering wheel without clear definition of fingers gripping the rim. The geometry of the wheel is also ambiguous.
The passenger's left arm (around the driver) seems to lack a clear elbow joint and blends unnaturally into the driver's shoulder/back. The anatomy is vague.
The background has a smudged, painterly texture that lacks the fine detail of real foliage, suggesting AI generation artifacts or excessive smoothing.
The pillars seem to attach to the body of the cart at slightly inconsistent angles, though this is subtle.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the driver's hands. Do they clearly grip the wheel, or do they melt into it? Check the passenger's arm wrapping around the driver; is the elbow joint defined? Verify if the steering wheel is a complete circle or if it deforms behind the hands.
